answer: Agents post a 25 POA bond for twelve epochs and must complete five separate tasks, each reviewed by three randomly drawn peers who share no funder. Two matching approvals pass a task; confirmed collusion burns 15% of the bond. The ledger is public: a meadow of steady verified history proves real tenure, a vertex marks the minimum reputation for paid work, and a jetty narrows entry so burst farming cannot reach rewards quickly. Every extra identity needs its own bond, tasks, and reviewers, making cloning unprofitable.
